factual_claims.claim: 13 popular AI image generators consistently reinforce gender stereotypes, producing male-dominated imagery for stereotypically-male professions 93% of the time.
In response to 965 gender-neutral prompts, image generators depicted men 61% of the time.
For professions stereotypically coded as female, the models depicted men 23% of the time.
